paper_audit.interpretation: FC upper triangle and site/sex/age inputs; RFE and VAE create equal 500-D sizes, not demonstrated semantic alignment. Original shared embedding is the arithmetic mean of modality GTUNet outputs; specific branches remain in fusion. Training-only projection alignment is added at the two 16-D outputs. VAE, AMRS, graph, encoders, fusion and classifier stay fixed.
paper_audit.paper_code_differences: Paper: 300 classifier epochs, 8:1:1, correlation similarity and multi-head/LN diagram. Source/history: 500 epochs, 81:9:10, torch Euclidean similarity, one attention head and no explicit LN. Experiments preserve source/history, not silently the textual settings.

limitations: Inherited cross-fold RFE leakage; no clinical generalization claim
Same-site transductive CV is not leave-site-out validation
No explicit identifiability of private vs shared information
Other users' workloads may share both PPUs; do not stop them
